dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body section towards a tapered posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized convex protrusion visible on the left lateral margin at the mid-section; the right margin is relatively linear.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: High-gradient, sharp boundary between the light-pigmented dorsal plane and the low-reflectance water.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, dark transverse mark with high contrast is visible on the anterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark linear mark or lesion is present on the anterior section of the visible dorsal plane.
